correctness.rationale: The coefficient ideal defines exactly 16m reduced complete-intersection points on the smooth torus: f1 and f2 are local regular parameters at each joint root, giving the exact invertible ideal on the blowup. The 3-coefficient surjection onto O(-D) has rank-two kernel; local charts t=sz and s=tz yield equations u+zv and zu+v, proving smoothness and a projective birational small morphism. The non-isomorphism fibers are P1 only above the singular A1-lines. Canonical determinants K_Z=O(D), det K=O(D) give K_Y trivial, matching Cartier K_X; Pic and motive follow from vector-bundle and point-blowup identities. CHECK.py ran exact SymPy polynomial calculations for nine n and verifies universal chart algebra and motivic equalities; the all-m proof is in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: Projective compatibility of local small resolutions is a substantive global obstruction question, not settled by a list of conifold germs. The proof constructs one algebraic projective crepant model uniformly for every m, identifies every exceptional ruled surface, and computes its motivic class, Picard group and ordinary integral homology. These describe the actual nonsingular birational model of naturally defined affine fourfolds and provide comparison invariants beyond the source regular-locus homology; not merely a new notation for the 16m count.
